title: Delete sutra_orient (tool, handler, and now-dead conventions describe_patterns)
description:
DECISION LANDED: delete orient (see decisions). Implementation scope:

1. Remove the sutra_orient MCP tool: registration/dispatch in src/mcp.rs, OrientArgs, and src/tools/orient.rs (handler + helpers: resolve_scope, constraints_for_component, hidden_coupling_for_component, constraint_detail, extract_component_sym_attrs, handle). Remove the module from src/tools/mod.rs.
2. Now-dead conventions surface: after sutra/313, orient is the LAST consumer of describe_patterns / observed_patterns. Verify via sutra_refs, then remove describe_patterns and any ObservedPattern type left with no other caller. Keep the FormalContext core + attribute extraction (may serve future constraint authoring).
3. Remove orient from help text (sutra_help recipes), docs/conventions-map.md references, and any MCP tool-count/inventory strings.
4. Remove orient tests (the tests module in src/tools/orient.rs) and any cross-tool test that invokes orient.

SEQUENCING: land AFTER sutra/313 (313 intentionally leaves describe_patterns intact "because orient uses it"; deleting orient is what makes it dead). Coordinate so the tree is green between the two.

VERIFY: cargo test green; confirm the MCP tool list no longer advertises sutra_orient and sutra v0.9.0's tool count / server instructions are updated.

Closes sutra/314, 315, 316 as wontfix (superseded).

decisions.decision: Delete sutra_orient outright rather than realign it.
decisions.rationale: Removing FCA conventions (sutra/313) strips orient of its only unique surface (observed_patterns). What remains bundles constraints/health/lessons/hidden-coupling, each a worse-packaged version of a focused tool (sutra_constraints/health/lessons/cochange) that an inference-capable consumer composes on demand — same principle that demolished the FCA lifecycle (lesson 019f8a3f). Usage corroborates: 7 calls ever, ~86% erroring.
decisions.rejected_alternative: Realign to intuition (fix sutra/314-316, make scope optional). Rejected: investing in an aggregator after deleting its differentiator, to compete with four tools that already do each job better.

execution_record: Went as planned. Removed: sutra_orient #[tool] method (mcp.rs), OrientArgs+handler+module (src/tools/orient.rs moved out), `pub mod orient` (tools/mod.rs), tools_meta core-tools inventory entry, help.rs orient Topic. Confirmed orient was the last consumer of describe_patterns/ObservedPattern via sutra_impact (0 callers) and deleted both plus MAX_ORIENT_PATTERNS. Cascade: review::collect_toolchain_pairs became dead (orient was its only caller) — removed it too. Kept FormalContext::count_with_attrs/exemplars_for (publicly re-exported API, tested, task said keep FCA core). Fixed stale doc-comments in guard.rs and lessons.rs (orient no longer one of the surfacing callers). Docs: conventions-map.md orient references removed; sutra root CLAUDE.md lessons-surfacing line. Tool count/roster in MCP server instructions is computed from tool_router.map, so it updated automatically — no manual string edit. cargo test: 1545 passed, 0 failed. Note: conventions-map.md was already partly stale vs sutra/313 (still describes the removed deviation review report) — left that untouched (313's debt). README.md and health-map/constraints-map still reference orient in narrative/inventory — filed follow-up (not in this task's scope).
